card.name: Lifespan and age-span expressions
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces right before a stretch of years or time is stated, such as 'live' in 'live long enough' or 'live to be', and the digits before 'years old'. Seen mostly in general web text about aging, longevity and ages.

modes.label: Live to an age
modes.description: The verb 'live' in clauses about surviving to a great age.

modes.label: Long spans of time
modes.description: Words or number pieces just before a count of years, such as ages or ancient dates.
modes.example: ancient people used to live to be<< >>100 years old and now people

modes.label: Long waits
modes.description: Verbs before a phrase about a long period of time.
modes.example: in<< waiting>> such long periods of time before granting such

card.writes: It suppresses 'duration' words, so it seems to steer the next word toward a number of years instead of the word duration.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how many years someone lives or how long something lasts.
